title: Git history note lines
responsibility: Serializes, merges and validates append-only history note entries tied to a particular source commit.

inputs.name: noteLine.entry
inputs.description: Validated history entry to serialize canonically.

inputs.name: noteLines.entries
inputs.description: History entries to write in their existing order.

inputs.name: noteCommit.entry
inputs.description: History entry whose owning source commit should be read.

inputs.name: mergeNoteLines.left
inputs.description: First note text to union with the second.

inputs.name: mergeNoteLines.right
inputs.description: Second note text to union with the first.

inputs.name: readNoteLines.text
inputs.description: Newline-delimited note text to validate line by line.

inputs.name: readNoteLines.commit
inputs.description: Commit the note belongs to; entries naming a different commit are rejected.

outputs.name: noteLine
outputs.description: Canonical JSON for one entry, without an added newline.

outputs.name: noteLines
outputs.description: Canonical JSON entries each followed by a newline; an empty list produces empty text.

outputs.name: noteCommit
outputs.description: Verification source.commit or the commit field of a reason/legacy entry.

outputs.name: mergeNoteLines
outputs.description: Sorted unique nonblank lines, each with a trailing newline. The union does not validate or canonicalize the supplied lines.

outputs.name: readNoteLines
outputs.description: Valid entries for the requested commit in line order and problems identifying malformed or foreign-commit lines; blank lines are ignored.
